name: puffin
notes: fork of KangLiao929/Puffin; Puffin-World is the subproject we train

name: trellis2
notes: GS-Voxel has no code; o-voxel is its serialisation layer, and the sparse VAE architecture is the reference

name: gsplat
notes: pinned to v1.5.3 to match the installed wheel; HEAD examples use gsplat.losses which the wheel lacks

name: trellis
notes: E07 stress test: the only public learned 3D generator that emits 3DGS; object-level by its own README

name: worldgrow
notes: AAAI 2026 Oral; block-wise infinite indoor world growth over TRELLIS SLAT. Submodules carry forked cumm-int32/spconv-int32, which the README says the stock ones cannot replace.

name: worldsculpt
notes: compositional mesh scenes from posed views with instance masks and 3D boxes; TRELLIS.2 + Pixal3D base with LoRA on top. Inference only; no training code.

name: surflo
notes: NeurIPS 2026 Oral; feed-forward surface from 2-32 unposed views (VGGT-1B + flow matching). Guided mode fits a full SH-3 3DGS it never writes out. Weights CC BY-NC 4.0, code Inria/MPII GS licence (research only).
